newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down, seen mixed.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down, seen mixed.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended down on Sunday in lacklustre trade overshadowed by elections to the board of the Karachi Stock Exchange, dealers said.
They saw the index opening mixed on position-squaring on Monday's settlement day, with big investors staying out.

The Karachi 100-share index fell 21.66 points, or 1.53 percent, drifting through the 1,400-point barrier, to end at 1,391.93. Losers led gainers 190 to 38. Turnover fell to 23.32 million shares from 32.40 million in the previous session.
Askari Bank fell 1.25 rupees to 24 rupees and Faysal Bank 0.90 to 21.20. Dewan Salman Fibre fell 2.75 to 31.50 and Dhan Fibre 0.40 to 5.35.
Hub Power Co fell 0.45 to 32.95. Pakistan State Oil fell 7.0 to 361. PTCL fell 0.35 to 26.7 0.54 0.81
